title: How to Reduce Non-Value-Added Work in Engineering — Survey Results
summary: Tech-Clarity survey of 228 manufacturers measuring time mechanical engineers spend on non-value-added work; the load-bearing industry-standard baseline (~33% non-value-added, ~20% from outdated info, ~15% on data management).

title: Accelerating the Process of Engineering Change Orders: Capacity and Congestion Effects
summary: INSEAD academic case-study aggregation of ECO cost data; quotes practicing engineers at US $10K routine to US $100Ks late-stage per change order.

title: Change Orders Impact on Project Cost
summary: Peer-reviewed ASEE/AFIT regression study; projects with engineering changes overran final cost by 72% versus 11% for projects without.

title: Avoid 5 CAD Design Time Wasters
summary: Tech-Clarity eBook categorising the five most common CAD time-waster sources from manufacturer interviews.

title: Reduce Scrap and Rework Costs — Benchmarking
summary: ASQ member-data benchmarking: average manufacturer 2.2% of revenue lost to scrap and rework; world-class <0.6%. Total cost of poor quality ranges 10–30% of revenue.

title: What is the Value of GD&T Implementation?
summary: Dimensional Control Systems geometric analysis showing correct GD&T on circular features widens acceptance zone by 57%, cutting false-reject scrap on hole-pattern parts.

title: Autodesk's Project Bernini proves generative CAD is coming
summary: Engineering.com trade-press recap of Autodesk Bernini announcement and Neural CAD trajectory at AU 2025; vendor positioning that 80–90% of routine design tasks are automatable.

title: Teradyne — Teamcenter Case Study (Engineering Change Order)
summary: Siemens vendor case study: Teradyne cut ECO cycle by 84% and saved ~US $2M/year after Teamcenter rollout. Flagged vendor source.

title: Increased Productivity in Engineer-to-Order Production
summary: Industry-Science.com article citing a German shipyard study attributing ~10% of manufacturing and assembly hours to engineering changes.

title: Dassault Systèmes 2024 Universal Registration Document and SOLIDWORKS 2025 Launch
summary: Dassault Systèmes filed annual report + SOLIDWORKS 2025 press release: >8M SOLIDWORKS users, ~1.5M commercial seats, ~285K customers, 44% of new MCAD seats in 2024 = SOLIDWORKS.

title: CIMdata Publishes 2025 PLM Industry Review & Trends Report
summary: DailyCADCAM independent summary of CIMdata's 2025 PLM Industry Review; PDM software market = US $2.53B in 2023.

title: Zoo.dev — Turning on Billing for Text-to-CAD + Pricing Page
summary: Zoo vendor announcement: Text-to-CAD billed per-second from Oct 14 2025 at US $0.0083/sec (US $0.50/min); typical generation $0.08–$0.25/prompt; 'large majority of API calls last 10–30 sec'.

title: Project Bernini (Autodesk Research)
summary: Autodesk Research project page describing Bernini text-to-3D-shape diffusion model; vendor disclosure corroborated by Engineering.com [S07].

title: AI Capabilities in SOLIDWORKS 2025: Redefining Design Intelligence
summary: Engineers Rule independent trade-press review of SOLIDWORKS 2025/2026 AI feature set; positioned as 'co-pilot not auto-pilot', with Backflip plug-in producing parametric models from mesh.

title: Is Text-to-CAD the Future of Product Design?
summary: Independent blog confirming Zoo pricing details: 40 free min/month then $0.50/min; per-second billing live since 2025-09-26.

title: KittyCAD/text-to-cad-ui (Open-Source UI Repo)
summary: Zoo Text-to-CAD UI repository: 276 stars; archived 2026-01-16; only UI is open-source, model and KCL backend remain proprietary.

title: Open Source AI Text-to-CAD Software by Zoo Unlocks Accessible 3D Design
summary: 3D Printing Industry coverage of Zoo Text-to-CAD release; documented limitation: 'works best with single objects, not complicated groupings of parts'.

title: Autodesk Shows Its AI Hand (Project Bernini → Neural CAD)
summary: AEC Magazine / DEVELOP3D coverage: Project Bernini remains a research proof-of-concept evolving into 'Neural CAD' for Fusion/Forma; no commercial NL→parametric CAD product yet from Autodesk.

title: Autodesk Assistant — Fusion Blog
summary: Autodesk official blog: Autodesk Assistant shipped as a support chatbot in Fusion/Inventor/Moldflow/Vault in early 2025, not a geometry generator.

title: Autodesk Announces Fusion MCP Servers and More AI Updates
summary: Engineering.com: Autodesk Fusion MCP servers (2025/2026) — an agentic LLM-frontend / deterministic-backend interface; validates the architecture sw-copilot uses.

title: PTC Announces Latest Onshape AI Advisor Release
summary: PTC press release: Onshape AI Advisor launched Oct 2025 as an embedded advisor/chatbot, not NL→geometry; 'automated geometry creation' listed as future/exploratory.

title: PTC Launches Creo 12
summary: PTC press release: Creo 12 (June 2025) added thermal physics to generative design but no NL→CAD prompt interface.

title: CAD-MLLM (Multimodal LLM for Parametric CAD)
summary: Academic project (2024–2025): released evaluation code and the Omni-CAD dataset but NOT model weights as of May 2025; no drop-in OSS competitor exists.

title: BlenderLLM
summary: Open-weight LLM (2024-12-17) targeting Blender Python scripts, not parametric CAD or SolidWorks; confirms no public-weight model exists for parametric MCAD.

title: Seek-CAD: Self-Refined NL→Parametric CAD
summary: arXiv paper demonstrating self-refined NL→parametric CAD via local DeepSeek inference; validates the 'LLM + validation loop' architecture but no tooling integration.

title: AI vs. SolidWorks API: The Ultimate Macro Challenge
summary: CADmunity forum thread: AI-generated SolidWorks macros pass on ~30% of first attempts; supplying type-library signatures raises success to >80%. Exactly the determinism gap sw-copilot closes.

title: New Solidworks AI Agents Added at 3DExperience World 2026
summary: DEVELOP3D coverage of 3DEXPERIENCE World 2026: LEO/MARIE/AURA 'Virtual Companions'; LEO launches mid-2026, MARIE later; require 3DEXPERIENCE cloud, leaving SW 2021 desktop install base unserved.

title: 3DX World — SOLIDWORKS AI Recap (Hawk Ridge)
summary: Hawk Ridge / GoEngineer 2026 recaps: headline generative features are 'real features coming later this year' — not shipping; opens credibility-by-shipping window for an actually-working free tool.

title: 73% of Drawing Reviews Could Be Automated, Suggests New Survey
summary: Capvidia/DEVELOP3D survey of 250 US/EU engineering leaders: 73% of drawing reviews automatable; 96% plan to adopt AI 2D review within 1–2 years; only 55% of company standards documented, current, and frequently used.

title: 10 AI Tools Coming to SolidWorks in 2026
summary: Engineering.com listing of every Dassault AI feature as roadmap/beta — confirms incumbent demos vastly outpace incumbent shipping.

title: 3DX World 2026 SOLIDWORKS AI Recap (demo content)
summary: Same source as [S28]; specifically documents the keynote demos that resonated with audiences — reverse-engineering 2D drawings to parametric models, generating manufacturable parts from sketches, wind-loaded water tank frame 'in minutes'.

title: Autodesk Shows Its AI Hand — Editable Output Theme
summary: Same source as [S18]; specifically captures the practitioner preference for editable parametric output over opaque mesh blobs ('fully editable 3D CAD models').

title: New AI Agent Learns to Use CAD to Create 3D Objects from Sketches
summary: MIT News: research agent learning CAD by watching designer UI moves; implies engineer audiences respond to 'compiles to real CAD operations' framing over 'generates STEP files'.
